ops.title: Three lr tooling defects from root-2: causes and #3784
ops.body: (1) lr coordinator next: the cursor held a node-local seq. The Mac's 575540 selected nothing on the Sprite, whose seqs for the same records sit near 396,000. Fixed in yasyf/cc-skills#3784 (b2c9785): the cursor holds the record name and time, and a read resolves the name or refuses while the store lacks it. An old bare-seq cursor refuses and says to delete it. (3) readback_gate: on a -fix lane, a failed or timed-out incident read (lr incident written) made the whole gate pass unchecked. It now counts the lane as not exempt and runs the read-back check. On an empty store the read takes 26-31 ms (#3751), and actions.py timed out at 10 s on the same kind of box before #3751, so the 10 s comes from host load. (4) captain-hook broad-search: a scoped rg under go/sand/next/internal/vm_run passes, checked live with relative and absolute paths. A recursive grep with no --include over any directory is refused on purpose: yasyf/captain-hook search.py tests block 'grep -rn needle infra/'. Record 326@9214d094 quotes the grep message, so the lane ran grep -r. No captain-hook change was made.
